slides.lead: What I'd tell anyone starting something with family.
I build the app. My brother is in it with me. Two people, one neighbor app.
"We'll both handle it" means nobody does. Decide who owns what, out loud.
A shared note with what you decided and why saves a lot of "I thought we said…"
You are still family after the meeting. Keep the debate about the product.
No contracts to negotiate, no politics. Just decide and move.

slides.h2: Would you start a company with family?
